transitions.effect: Commit state CAS and immutable command/result audit atomically; retry returns the stored outcome without replay.

transitions.guard: Owner-authorized run command; AGENT_RUN.row_version compare-and-swap and (thread_id,idempotency_key) command identity. If prior_attempt_id is present, prior attempt must be terminal and exactly one Agent JOB RUNTIME_RESOURCE_REF with agent_run_id=prior_attempt_id must contain observed_uid plus schema-valid write_revocation_json; otherwise reject and keep mutation blocked.
transitions.effect: Execution/outcome pair must remain legal atomically; append transition audit.

In one PostgreSQL transaction lock PROJECT/WORKSPACE/PREVIEW_ROUTE, re-check prior generation, snapshot, route generation and route status, CAS-update all pointers, mark RESTORE_RESULT AVAILABLE, journal_decision=COMMIT, journal_phase=COMMITTED and cutover_committed_at; any mismatch rolls back everything.
transitions.effect: After DB commit, controller reconciles target generation, verifies health, then resumes route; source and prior generation remain retained until journal closure.

Require journal_decision=ROLLBACK and successful single-transaction restoration/verification of prior generation, snapshot, route generation and exact prior route status; mark the always-present provisional RESTORE_RESULT INVALID.
transitions.effect: Set journal_phase=REVERSED, keep cutover_committed_at NULL, verify prior runtime/route health, then and only then restore prior_route_status; if prior status was not READY do not invent READY.

transitions.guard: Owner-authorized Restore; RESTORE_JOB.row_version compare-and-swap plus unique (project_id,idempotency_key); same retry returns this row.
transitions.effect: Set journal_phase=MANUAL_INTERVENTION; mark the always-present provisional RESTORE_RESULT INVALID/quarantined, preserve before-image and failure evidence, keep route withdrawn and all mutations blocked. Never claim rollback success or resume traffic.
